plan.change: Add an isolated interactive continuous-trade Lab with four one-screen placement gestures and auto-restocking-by-recipe simulation
canonicalSources: User request to build a one-screen, low-tap continuous-trade Lab
expectedChanges: Add standalone HTML/CSS/JS Lab in new experiment directory; no native game imports, save, or distribution
Compare tap, slider, drag and draw-line gestures with a common relation-establishment outcome
Simulate recurring shipment from same-recipe lots across release batches; stockout pauses but retains relation; distinct recipe requires explicit new offer
Show one-screen shelf/store relation, month advance, same-recipe new bottling, operation counts and replayable JSON export
Do not imply mock demand/stock values match production
manualChecks: Open standalone Lab at 360/375/390 CSS widths
Try all four gestures including touch and reduced motion
Advance months, run out of stock, create new same-recipe release; verify relationship remains
Confirm no native saved-state writes; iPhone Safari still unverified
ownerDecisions: User authorized an exploratory trade Lab with fewer taps, unified shop handling and gesture comparison; does not authorize native integration or Production
hqDecisions: Simulated trade data only; no native save or shipping semantics. Existing continuous trade rules are not modified.
rulesApplied: Limited validation, related browser/manual checks, required CI
Keep prior Lab untouched; no production changes
plan.rollback: Revert only added experiment directory and Plan Lock; no saved data affected.
outOfScope: Real shop model and real saved state
plan.promotion: Staging isolated experiment page only; author will evaluate touch feel before possible integration.
unverified: Physical iPhone Safari, VoiceOver, reduced motion and long play are not yet tested
plan.problem: Manual placement and shop-specific shipping introduce repetitive actions and do not scale as shops increase. Need test more tactile one-screen gestures and persistent trade relations.
plan.currentContract: Existing Lab v073 allocates bottles explicitly to restaurants/liquor with a confirm; production separate supermarket automatic shipment. Both preserved unchanged.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: Current Lab cannot compare drag/line/slider to tap for one-time trade initiation or continuity across release sellout.
plan.design: Use an isolated deterministic mock simulator: minimal initial delivery per shop, recurring recipe-bound shipments without manual replenishment, stand-by when unavailable, resume when same recipe returns.
alternativesRejected: Direct integration into production placement model without player validation
plan.compatibility: No imports/exports shared with native game; HTML page is self-contained.
boundaryCases: New flavor explicitly replacing shop relation
Multiple shops sharing recipe and depleting stock
Touch cancel and no store target
Repeated linking same recipe is a no-op
testPlan: Focused manual interaction comparison in responsive browser
Required CI and Pages success before marking Staging published
plan.promotionRisk: Isolated Staging-only interactive mock has no save or production writes; limited runtime and touch accessibility risk. No shared runtime changes; browser interactions require device verification before any game integration.
